candidates.title: Will the President's approval rating be below 37.4 according to RealClearPolitics?
candidates.rules_primary: If the President's approval rating is below 37.4% at 11:00 AM ET on November 27, 2026 according to RealClearPolitics, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on November 27, 2026.

candidates.title: Will it rain in Columbus on Nov 25, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLICMH in Columbus in Nov 25, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Data for CLICMH can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 43-44° on Nov 25, 2026?

Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

candidates.title: Will the Democratic party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Democratic party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 27, 2026 be above $0.80?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 27, 2026 is above $0.80, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 be above 336.700?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 is above 336.700, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The Underlying is the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ Consumer Price Index News Release Table 1 for November 2026. Specifically, the value used will be the “All items” value under the “Unadjusted indexes” column for November 2026. This market will resolve according to the first value published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the scheduled Consumer Price Index release for November 2026. Subsequent revisions will not affect the market.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 0.5%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2027 is above 0.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2027 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2027, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.

candidates.title: Will a bill ending self rule in Washington DC become law before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.yes_sub_title: A bill ending self rule in Washington DC
candidates.rules_primary: If a bill ending self rule in Washington DC becomes law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Christopher Waller as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Christopher Waller is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of Christopher Waller's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.
